fullName.value: Zinc finger CW-type PWWP domain protein 1

texts.value: Dual histone methylation reader specific for PRDM9-catalyzed histone marks (H3K4me3 and H3K36me3) (PubMed:20826339, PubMed:32744506). Facilitates the repair of PRDM9-induced meiotic double-strand breaks (DSBs) (By similarity). Essential for male fertility and spermatogenesis (By similarity). Required for meiosis prophase I progression in male but not in female germ cells (By similarity)
The CW-TYPE zinc finger mediates its binding to trimethylated histone H3K4me3
